testcase.system-out: Scenario: Open Ribbon customization from the Sketch panel title ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/planar-sketch-empty-xy.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software with Sketch1 being edited ✔ And a part has an active editable sketch in the MCAD Software ✔ When the user opens Customize User Commands from the Create panel title context menu ✔ Then the Customize dialog opens on the Ribbon tab ✔ And Ribbon, Keyboard and Marking Menu tabs are available ✔ And the command source is All Commands ✔ And the target is Part | Sketch ✔ And the target command list is empty ✔ When the user closes the dialog without making changes ✔ Then the editable sketch remains active and unchanged
